OCI isolation adds about 207 milliseconds p50 over a direct static CPU-process lower bound; it does not predict GPU model latency.

recommendations.statement: Retain the reviewed v1 external acceptance-to-first-valid-response ledger for pre-resolved benchmark cohorts, and version its acceptance target before using it for the model-id-plus-input production ingress.
recommendations.rollback: Keep v1 evidence classified as pre-resolved benchmark evidence and reject production promotion until a reviewed v2 ledger preserves T0 without pre-resolving artifact identity.

recommendations.statement: Resolve immutable model, image, artifact, validator, hardware, and fallback identity from the versioned catalog before placement.
recommendations.rollback: Pin the previous catalog digest and reject requests whose identity cannot resolve under it.

recommendations.statement: Use Kubernetes for fleet ownership and baseline serving while evaluating a signed, generation-fenced node-local OCI supervisor for the single-GPU data-plane hot path.
recommendations.rollback: Set node-local routing weight to zero, fence its generation, drain it, verify cleanup, and serve through the previous-good Kubernetes backend digest.

recommendations.statement: Choose the node with the lowest verified switch cost subject to a queue-depth cap; use digest-addressed L0/L1/L2 tiers and keep prefetch disabled until real transitions justify it.
recommendations.rollback: Return to least-loaded placement with no prefetch while preserving the same ledger and cache-integrity gates.

recommendations.statement: Snapshot restore is an optional launch strategy, never a catalog-wide backend; any binding, signature, topology, or semantic failure descends exactly once to conventional local start.
recommendations.rollback: Disable the snapshot strategy by catalog version and retain conventional launch for the exact workload identity.

recommendations.statement: Evaluate Cerebrium only as the matched external comparator and a possible deadline-aware capacity-miss fallback after entitlement, identity, semantic, cost, cleanup, and raw-cohort gates pass.
recommendations.rollback: Set external routing weight to zero and fail capacity misses explicitly or queue them within the caller deadline.

recommendations.statement: Use Modal documentation only as managed-runtime design input; do not execute, compare, rank, or route traffic to it in this program.
recommendations.rollback: Remove the appendix reference; no runtime or traffic change exists.

recommendations.statement: Promote no backend or switch implementation until the listed live cohorts, replacements, capacity/cost model, and chaos gates close under independent review.

scenarios.name: same_model_hot
scenarios.route: Keep the exact model generation on its current healthy node and issue inference through the target-neutral local endpoint.
scenarios.fallback: Re-resolve and enter idle_local if the generation or health proof is stale.

scenarios.name: idle_local
scenarios.route: Acquire the node lease, verify L1 content and launch either a compatible signed snapshot or the conventional image.
scenarios.fallback: Use a_to_b_remote semantics if any required byte is absent or unverifiable.

scenarios.name: a_to_b_local
scenarios.route: Fence A admission, bounded-drain, terminate, actively scrub, prove exact GPU/runtime cleanup, then launch and semantically validate B.
scenarios.fallback: Quarantine the node and re-place B; never admit B on an unverified GPU.

scenarios.name: a_to_b_remote
scenarios.route: Perform the same fenced reclaim, localize immutable B bytes from L2 after T0, publish L1 atomically, then launch and validate.
scenarios.fallback: Try another capacity pool within deadline or fail explicitly; do not reuse stale or foreign bytes.

scenarios.name: checkpoint_fallback
scenarios.route: Verify the full checkpoint binding and signature; on one incompatibility or restore failure, scrub and descend once to conventional local start for the same identity.
scenarios.fallback: Conventional local start exactly once, then explicit failure or re-placement.

scenarios.name: capacity_miss
scenarios.route: Choose fresh internal capacity, matched Cerebrium capacity, bounded queueing, or an explicit failure using the caller deadline and policy version.
scenarios.fallback: Never hide the miss or change model/input identity; external routing remains disabled until its live gate passes.

backends.name: kubernetes
backends.role: Fleet/control-plane default and empirical internal baseline; node-local hot path may operate beneath its ownership only after fencing proof.

backends.name: node-vm
backends.role: Candidate dedicated single-GPU data-plane path with OCI isolation and no provider/Kubernetes call after T0.

backends.name: cerebrium
backends.role: Sole external matched comparator and disabled-by-default capacity-miss candidate.

tiers.name: L1_verified_local
tiers.verification: content hash plus fs-verity and signed binding

tiers.name: L2_remote_immutable
tiers.verification: digest-pinned publication and request-causal byte receipt

cache_policy.prefetch_promotion: Enable only when measured transition telemetry improves product p95 without exceeding the approved byte/cost budget.

latency_classes.name: fast-switch
latency_classes.note: The 30-second external-boundary p95 is an unratified program objective and executable candidate gate, not an approved product SLO. Product owners must ratify or replace it and define p99 before promotion.

latency_classes.name: standard-on-demand
latency_classes.note: Must beat or equal the frozen production baseline for the exact workload; absolute budget awaits capacity/cost evidence and product approval.

latency_classes.name: large-multi-gpu
latency_classes.note: Queue/asynchronous semantics and absolute latency budget must be approved before serving.

budgets.request_cost_rule: No route is promoted without p50/p95 cost per valid response, failed-attempt cost, warm-idle cost, and cleanup tail from actual receipts.

apis.name: AcceptRequest
apis.idempotency: tenant plus client key returns the original accepted request/attempt and input digest

apis.name: ResolveCatalog
apis.idempotency: request plus catalog digest resolves once or returns the same terminal resolution denial

apis.name: PlaceAttempt
apis.idempotency: request/attempt plus policy and snapshot digests is a compare-and-set placement decision

apis.name: CommitAttemptContext
apis.idempotency: request/attempt plus canonical context digest commits one immutable post-placement context and replays its receipt

apis.name: ApplyNodeCommand
apis.idempotency: command id and monotonic node sequence replay the durable action receipt; stale or conflicting commands fail

apis.name: DispatchInference
apis.idempotency: request/attempt execution key returns the same raw-output receipt and never invokes twice

apis.name: ValidateResponse
apis.idempotency: raw output plus validator digest returns the same semantic receipt

apis.name: CommitResponse
apis.idempotency: tenant plus client key commits one semantic result; every replay returns the byte-identical committed response

apis.name: LeaseResources
apis.idempotency: immutable plan digest creates at most one exact resource set

apis.name: CommitAttempt
apis.idempotency: request/attempt commits one terminal trace/accounting/cleanup tuple
